scope.initial_values: All210 unordered four-number sets chosen without replacement from1..10; every root is in the training domain. No unseen-root or larger-domain claim.
scope.goals: 21,24 and configured complete intermediate targets; two/three-number suffixes. Local held targets can occur in other initial-question graphs.
scope.encoding: Exact rational_bits; 16-bit absolute numerator and denominator; overflow raises.
scope.inference: Every legal arithmetic action supplied by environment; frozen Qmap selects greedily and exact equality stops. No search or exact graph queries.

limitations: Passed every basic80% completion/reachability gate, not every90% target. Held two-number test977/1195 and forced target switching41/47 remain weak. No convergence claim.
